records.title: sux-controls-rerun: the A/B key, opened after every verdict was recorded
records.body: The grader's verdicts for all four packs were complete and hashed at 2026-10-19 19:33:14 UTC (verdicts.json sha256 301edcd1..., verdicts-notes.md 2c68f701..., both LF so the as-written and LF hashes coincide; the record is the evidence file verdicts.sha256). The key was opened at 19:33:27 UTC. The key file is published unchanged as ab-key.json; its sha256 a52bd621347a1d0595b78a8e628e8051c2208fbb8ef0b50c23bbbd83125d1a35 is the value written in pre-registration 01M5A5K2C9SRMCE6VFGXVK1Y4F before any report existed. The grader's inputs (the four packs, the rules and the code clone head) were hashed before it started and were unchanged after; that record is grader-inputs.sha256.
